output.summary: Tropical fruit tree native to Melanesia and coastal Southeast Asia. Its oval fruits ripen from hard green to golden yellow and have juicy, crunchy, mildly sour flesh eaten raw or prepared in drinks, preserves, salads and savoury dishes; young or mature leaves are also eaten in some regions.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit is eaten raw or prepared in many dishes and drinks; young or mature leaves are also eaten regionally.
